title: v1LoginResponse
description: Returns the allowed login method and information with the organization details

appEnv.description: Describes the env type. Possible values [ saas, self-hosted, quick-start, enterprise, airgap]

authType.description: Describes the default mode of authentication. Possible values [password, sso]

redirectUrl.description: Describes the default redirect Url for authentication. If authType is sso, it will have tenant configured saml/oidc idp url else it will be users organization url

rootDomain.description: Describes the domain url on which the saas is available

securityMode.description: Describes which security mode is enabled

ssoLogins.description: Just Inside. Describes the allowed social logins

totalTenants.description: Describes the total number of tenant present in the system

v1SsoLogin.description: Describes the allowed sso login details

displayName.description: Describes the display name for the sso login

logo.description: Describes the url path for the sso login

name.description: Describes the processed name for the sso login

redirectUri.description: Describes the sso login url for the authentication
